acceptanceCriteria: A call whose result exceeds the output bound returns a truncated page with next_offset (or a typed output-bound refusal naming the bound), never -32603.
Paging through with next_offset returns the same union as one unbounded call.
body: docs_flow with limit 256 on one flow subject returns JSON-RPC -32603 Internal error on a ~100k-record corpus (main-29c7eeb, main-fa8afe6); limit 64 returns 64 results. A response-size failure surfaces as an internal error.
title: GH #1255: docs_flow returns JSON-RPC -32603 when the result exceeds the output bound
